p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Driftshade Refuge, on a table in the final room with the barred door. *Fort Dawnguard Rooftop in Dayspring Canyon, on the northern tower, next to a bedroll. *Jorgen and Lami's House in Morthal, in a bucket on top of the barrel to the left of the bed. *Lost Echo Cave, on the altar. *Northwatch Keep, on a shelf behind the bar. *Sabre Cat Den, an unmarked location between Broken Tower Redoubt and Robber's Gorge, on the body of a dead hunter.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Ansilvund Burial Chambers, in the first room after the hallway with pendulum blades, lying on a pedestal. *Darklight Tower, on the fourth floor (Hagraven's Chamber), right before the entrance to Darklight Chambers. *Movarth's Lair, on a table between a bed and a shelf full of boots on the northern side of the room. *River Rapids Treasure Chest, an unmarked location southwest of Old Hroldan Inn. *Temple of Dibella Inner Sanctum in Markarth, on the bottom of the bookshelf.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Volkihar Keep, on a wall shelf in Harkon's room. *House of Clan Cruel-Sea in Windhelm, on a bookshelf in the northwestern bedroom on the upper floor. *Palace of the Kings Upstairs (Southern Section) in Windhelm, on a cupboard in the first room on the left. *Wreck of the Brinehammer Below Deck, in a small room with short steps and chairs. *Randomly found placed in the world. *Randomly sold by Urag gro-Shub. *Randomly looted from Warlocks, Giants and Vampires. *Randomly looted from Seekers in Apocrypha. *Randomly found in pods and vessels in Apocrypha.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Blind Cliff Bastion, carried by Petra. *Falion's House in Morthal, on a table at the bed. *Hall of the Dead in Markarth, on a shelf next to Brother Verulus' bed. *Haul of the Horkers, an unmarked location southeast of Winterhold, due north of Journeyman's Nook, in front of a chest. *Widow's Watch Ruins, in front of an expert locked chest on the top of the crumbled tower.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Sadri's Used Wares in Windhelm, under the counter. *Shriekwind Bastion, on a stone pedestal before the staircase leading to the word wall. *Shrine of Zenithar: Crumbling Bastion, an unmarked location east of Gjukar's Monument, on the stone table with the shrine. *Sorli's House in Stonehills, on the fireplace mantel.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Blackreach Arena, an unmarked location west of the War Quarters, on a table. *Bonechill Passage, before turning east, next to a skeleton with a knapsack. *Fort Dunstad Prison, top floor, on the bookcase next to the Alchemy Lab. Note: On your first visit (if you're not on the Civil War questline) the Fort will be occupied by Bandits. There's nothing of interest there. After clearing out the Fort and waiting for a few days, the Stormcloaks will move in. Now the book can be found. *Guardhouse in Morthal, to the right of the fireplace, behind a barrel and a basket. *Shrine of Talos: Cradlecrush Pond northeast of Cradlecrush Rock, at the foot of the shrine.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Fort Snowhawk, in the circular room on the bookshelf to the south. Note: On your first visit (if you're not on the Civil War questline) the Fort is occupied by Necromancers. The book can only be found then, cause after clearing out the fort and waiting for a few days, the Imperial Legion will move in, with distinct changes made to the interior layout. *Treva's Watch, on the upper floor, on a low bookshelf. *Randomly found placed in the world. *Randomly sold by Urag gro-Shub. *Randomly found in knapsacks.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Hag Rock Redoubt Interior, on a table on the ground floor. *Raldbthar, in the main bandits' camp (where Alain Dufont can be found during Mourning Never Comes), on the room divider. *Redoran's Retreat, on a crate in the farthest room. *Two Pine Ridge, an unmarked location east of Stendarr's Beacon, on a bedroll by the tree.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Engelmann's Sanctuary in Engelmann's Rest, on a shelf in the hagravens' room, to the right as you enter. *Rimerock Burrow, in the last room, on a small table to the right. *The Conjurer's Altar: Lake Ilinalta, an unmarked location near Lakeview Manor, on the altar. *The Lost Conjurer, an unmarked location in the mountains west of Bloodlet Throne. *The Mortar and Pestle in Dawnstar, under the counter.

p: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 5 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Belyn Hlaalu's House in Windhelm, behind a dresser in the southwestern corner upstairs. *Sacrificial Altar: Evergreen Woods, an unmarked location west of the Roadside Ruins, on the altar. *Sunderstone Gorge, on a pedestal in front of the word wall. Note: The explosion caused by the dying Flame Atronach may kick the book from its place, making it hard to locate. *The Poultry Reanimator: Lake Geir, an unmarked location south of Geirmund's Hall, carried by the necromancer.

p: Central Wall display in the Wyrmstooth Room in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Central Wall display in the Wyrmstooth Room in the Hall of Oddities.
det: Frostwind Bastion in Frostwind Folly, given by Alka if you choose to "ruffle that old bird's feathers". Note that the staff can't be acquired by simply killing her. To be able to enter Frostwind Folly, you need to embark on a rather elaborate (but completely unmarked) quest involving a series of readables. Reading one journal/note spawns the next, and so on, until you finally have the tool that makes it possible to enter Frostwind Folly. Massive Spoiler ahead! You have been warned! Show how to aquire the tool #Your journey starts by reading the "Dockmaster's Journal" in the Dockmaster's house at the Imperial Docks (the area where you first arrive on Wyrmstooth). #Travel to the Dwemer Tower south-east of . Here you will find "Donnar's Journal". #Donnar's corpse is found in the Cavern at . The "Marauder's Journal" can be found in one of the shacks, on the table next to the boss chest. #North-northeast of , on the shoreline adjacent to Belonir's Borg, you'll find the "Marauder's Last Words" on the boat. It mentions "Witches". #The witches are those of Belonir's Borg. Inside, up the stairs to the right, the "Witch's Journal" is found on an end table. #Finally, the "Runed Lexicon" can be found in Midden, on the table in the torture room before entering the great cavern, next to the arcane enchanter. Place the lexicon in the receptable at the Dwemer Tower, the lake will be drained and the entrance to Frostwind Folly is revealed. "Ok, but why can't I just put on waterbreathing gear, dive into the lake and enter without first having to zig-zag across the island?" Well, you can try, but the door just doesn't work. Probably because of water pressure.
nt: * Requires Wyrmstooth. *It should be noted that the infos on may be outdated. For up-to-date quest and location infos check the on the mod's article page (or the [https://drive.google.com/file/d/18nDoQaEcOK715jETPnD6JwN_5_7gIlfz/view pdf guide]).

p: Moon and Star Display on the Bottom Floor of the Dragonborn Hall.
h_hall: Moon and Star Display on the Bottom Floor of the Dragonborn Hall.
det: Kagrenar Depths, on a pedestal behind a locked door at the back of the Titan room. The door requires the "Kagrenar Tomb Key" found earlier. To get the key, you need to answer all three questions in Kagrenar correctly, and a side door will be unlocked. Enter the room and pick up the "Kagrenar Tomb Key". If you answered any of the questions incorrectly, this door will remain locked and cannot be opened, thus preventing you from reaching the tome. Proceed to the end of the hall and enter Kagrenar Depths to defeat The Ancient Centurion Titan.
nt: *Requires Moon and Star. *The Museum display accepts either this item or the translated book, Memories of Dorana.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Right Displays in the 1st Room of the Armor Displays.

det: Tolvald's Cave, in a magically sealed chest in Tolvald's Gap. Needs the Blessing of Akatosh or Mara or the Signet Ring of Sir Amiel to open.
nt: *If the Divine Crusader creation and its CCPH patch are installed, this item will be replaced by the Cuirass of the Crusader. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the Divine Crusader relics. There is information about the crusader relics in the book Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3. *The Crusader Display will always show the Heavy version of the armor, regardless of the type placed. *You can switch between the light and heavy version at any forge using 2 Silver Ingots. *This item is based on the Cuirass of the Crusader from The Elder Scrolls IV: Knights of the Nine. *The enchantment increases with the player's level: Stage 1: up to Level 14, Stage 2: Level 15-24, Stage 3: Level 25-34, Stage 4: Level 35-44, Stage 5: Level 45-54, Stage 6: Level 55-64, Stage 7: Level 65 and up.

p: Right Wall - First Case display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Right Wall - First Case display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
det: A total of 11 can be found in various locations throughout Coldharbour. *Buro Temple, on a raised platform in the back, in the hands of a Dried Corpse. *Chapel of Arkay Cemetery, Chapel of Arkay, looted from Sir Torolf. *Gardener's House, in the attic, lying on the bed. *Holy Brothers of Marukh Priory, Marukh's Underground Priory, looted from Abbot Cosmas. *Holy Brothers of Marukh Priory, Marukh's Underground Priory, looted from the skeleton of Jhunal. *Inquisition Court Sewers, Conrad's room, on the lowest shelf next to a drum. *Malatar Mansion, looted from Mad King Dro'Zel. *Mitta Village, Abandoned House on the right, on an altar on the second floor. *Naarifin's Inquisition Court, looted from Inquisitor Naarifin. *Secret Cave of Mara's Worshippers, Temple of Mara, looted from Aria the Whisperer. *Waterfront District, Fort Verin, on a platform in the central hall, reached by jumping on a ledge from the upper bridge.
nt: *Requires Vigilant. *The increase of Magicka is permanent and stackable, so a total of 110 points can be gained (100 if you spare one to put on display).

p: Bookshelf 7 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 7 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: All locations are on Solstheim. *Raven Rock: **Alor House, downstairs in the right-hand bedroom, on a table next to the bed. **Glover Mallory's House, in the basement, at the bottom of a shelf to the right of the locked door (along with Vol. 2). **Morvayn Manor, on a shelf to the right of the throne (along with Vol. 2). **Temple of Raven Rock, downstairs in a bedroom to the left, on a table to the right behind a strongbox (along with Vol. 2). **The Bulwark, on the middle of a shelf on the left, at the end of the hall (along with Vol. 2). **The Bulwark Jail, on the middle of a shelf on the left, behind the expert-locked cell door (along with Vol. 2). *Bloodskal Barrow, in the reaver hideout at the end of the dungeon, on a shelf near the bed (along with Vol. 2). *Tel Mithryn Tower, on a bookshelf southeast of the levitator platform.

h_hall: Boots & Gloves Display on the Upper Gallery.
det: Spider cave in Fort Frostmoth on Solstheim, lying in front of a web in a small alcove with large spider eggs.
nt: *This item is based on the Boots of Blinding Speed from The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *Despite the enchantment description saying 5 times faster (500%), the actual speed increasement is 150%. *If the Netch Leather Armor creation and its CCPH patch are installed, this item is replaced by the CC Version.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Right Displays in the 1st Room of the Armor Displays.
h_hall: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: Mossy Glen Cave in Dayspring Canyon near Fort Dawnguard, in a magically sealed chest buried in a Skeever nest. Needs the Blessing of Kynareth or the Signet Ring of Sir Amiel to open.
nt: *If the Divine Crusader creation and its CCPH patch are installed, this item will be replaced by the CC version. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the Divine Crusader relics. There is information about the crusader relics in the book Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3. *The Crusader Display will always show the Heavy version of the armor, regardless of the type placed. *You can switch between the light and heavy version at any forge using 2 Silver Ingots. *This item is based on the Boots of the Crusader from The Elder Scrolls IV: Knights of the Nine. *The enchantment increases with the player's level: Stage 1: up to Level 14, Stage 2: Level 15-24, Stage 3: Level 25-34, Stage 4: Level 35-44, Stage 5: Level 45-54, Stage 6: Level 55 and up.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Right Displays in the 1st Room of the Armor Displays.
h_hall: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: *Mossy Glen Cave in Dayspring Canyon near Fort Dawnguard, in a magically sealed chest buried in a Skeever nest. Needs the Blessing of Kynareth or the Signet Ring of Sir Amiel to open. *A replica of the Boots is found on the corpse of Oren at Four Skull Lookout.
nt: *Requires Divine Crusader (replaces the LotD version). *You can switch between this item and the Reforged version at any forge using 1 Silver Ingot. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *Although there are separate displays for the standard and reforged versions, at least on one of them a replica must be placed since you can't have both originals. *You need to have either this item or the reforged version in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the Divine Crusader relics. There is information about the crusader relics in the book Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3. *This item is based on the Boots of the Crusader (Oblivion) from The Elder Scrolls IV: Knights of the Nine.

p: North-Eastern Wall Display - Right in the Fossil Mining Room above the Gallery of Natural Science.
h_hall: North-Eastern Wall Display - Right in the Fossil Mining Room above the Gallery of Natural Science.
det: *Can randomly be found when mining. *Integrated Legacy version only: **Randomly sold by Darnette Lauven. **Randomly found by Darnette Lauven if you have recruited her into the Explorer's Society and sent her out on fossil digging jobs. **Can randomly be traded via the Fossil Exchange Crate from five tier two fossils.
nt: *Requires Fossil Mining (Classic only). *x25px has been integrated into Legacy of the Dragonborn and should NOT be installed as a standalone mod. *Tier three fossil (see the Fossil Tiers section of the old mod page for information about the tiers). *See the Fossil Digsite Camp section of the old mod page for information about Darnette and the Fossil Exchange Crate. __NOTOC____NOEDITSECTION__ Category:Fossil Mining Category:Gallery of Natural Science Classic Category:Gallery of Natural Science SSE

p: Fishing: Right Wall Aquarium displays in the Hallway of the Hall of Wonders.
h_hall: Fishing: Right Wall Aquarium displays in the Hallway of the Hall of Wonders.
det: *Caught at Temperate Lakes fishing spots during clear weather (Uncommon). *Caught at Temperate Streams fishing spots during clear weather (Uncommon). *Randomly found in Fish Barrels. *Can be caught by hand in many temperate streams and rivers of Skyrim. *Can also be bred in a Fish Hatchery or the Aquarium in the Gallery of Natural Science.
nt: *Requires Fishing. *Large fish. *All catches are random, best chances for this fish to be caught: **Rod: Argonian Fishing Rod. **Time: Peak Hours (6am to 9am / 6pm to 9pm). Category:Creation Club Category:Fishing Category:Hall of Wonders __NOTOC____NOEDITSECTION__

p: v6: Kaidan display on the upper floor of the Explorer's Society Guild House. v5: Kaidan display in the Follower's Room.
h_hall: v6: Kaidan display on the upper floor of the Explorer's Society Guild House. v5: Kaidan display in the Follower's Room.
det: If you are romantically involved with Kaidan and you have fought a dragon together, he may give you this. It usually happens a short time after you've 'spent the night together' for the first time.

nt: *You can acquire two of the items if you're asking Malborn for a drink before choosing any other dialogue options. p: 8th Weapons Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Middle Display in the 3rd Room of the Weapon Displays.
h_hall: 8th Weapons Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: Roof of the World, an unmarked location at the very top of the Throat of the World, stuck into the rock. Walk away from the word wall and climb all the way up to the mountain peak.
nt: *The item is based on Dawnfang and Duskfang from Shivering Isles, the second expansion of The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. *If the Dawnfang & Duskfang creation and its CCPH patch are installed, this item will be replaced by the CC Version. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *The sword changes its appearance and enchantment depending on the time of day (dusk vs dawn). It needs 12 kills in a single day to receive the boost (the sword is now called Dawnfang/Duskfang Superior), and this will only last until it switches appearance again. *The enchantment increases with the player's level: Stage 1: up to Level 14, Stage 2: Level 15-29, Stage 3: Level 30-44, Stage 4: Level 45-59, Stage 5: Level 60-74, Stage 6: Level 75 and up.

p: Dibella Case display in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Dibella Case display in the Hall of Oddities.
det: 10 of these statues can be displayed in the museum, but you can find many more that are scattered all across Skyrim. They can be found in these places: *Benkongerike (first part of the caves), in the passage before the huge room with bridges. *Black-Briar Manor in Riften, in one of the bedrooms. This one respawns. *Brinewater Grotto, at the very back of the grotto, on a shelf. The Grotto is accessed from the East Empire Company Warehouse during the Thieves Guild quest Scoundrel's Folly. This one respawns. *Broken Tower Redoubt, east of Karthwasten. The statue is found on a top ledge inside the lower tower at the top left of the stairs behind some broken boulders. *Damphall Mine, in a room full of loot located behind a cave wall on top of some water. You need to swim underwater to get to this room. *Deekus' camp at Hela's Folly, on the ground by a bedroll. *Frossel on Solstheim, in the cavern to the west. *Riftweald Manor in Riften, on a shelf. It can be taken from the manor during the Thieves Guild quest 'The Pursuit'. *Temple of the Venerable Ones, behind the 6th door from the left. *In Velehk Sain's hidden treasure. If you release Velehk Sain, a Dremora pirate found in The Midden, he will give you his treasure map, which will allow you to find his hidden treasure. The treasure is found below a large statue of Talos to the west of the College of Winterhold. *Randomly looted from Rieklings and found in Riekling chests and huts on Solstheim. *Requires : Upper Pinewatch Mine , in a room at the end of the dungeon, behind the shelves.
nt: The statues must be placed manually on display and do not count towards the Museum total display count.

nt: *Requires Clockwork. *The smithing recipe is only available during the quest. p: Third row of the Rings display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Third row of the Rings display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
det: A total of 14 can be found in various locations throughout Coldharbour. *Arena, looted from the Gray Prince. *Fort Welkynd, bottom floor, in the circular room behind the lever-locked gate, on the table with the coffin chest. *Holy Brothers of Marukh Priory, Malada Aldmerisel, in the north-western room behind the apprentice-locked door, on the sarcophagus. *Inquisition Court District, in the window of the ruin east of the entrance gate, guarded by a Soul-Shriven Knight of the Nine. *Jhunal's Library, looted from Jhunal the Owl. *Lipsand Cave, looted from the Wasteland Guardian. *Mitta Village, Abandoned House, under the bed on the upper floor. *Old Temple of the Eight Divines, Prayer Hall, can be looted from Sir Berich if you decide to kill him (you'll lose Karma if you do!). This is the only way to obtain his Dragon Soul Stone. Although he can be made a follower, the Stone can't be traded. *Secret Cave of Mara's Worshippers, Temple of Mara, in the room to the north after entering, on the large table. *Tele Village, Abandoned House, on a shelf across the entrance. *Varla's Gate, looted from Menta Na, the flying Daedroth. *Waterfront District, Highwayman's General Store, hidden under the counter is sitting on. *Wellspring Cave, at the bottom, looted from the Mountain Eater. *Wellspring Cave, Underground Lake, in the window of the adept-locked room to the left of the stairway leading to Silorn's Priory.
nt: *Requires Vigilant.

p: Lost Vale Relics display on the upper level of the Hall of Lost Empires.
h_hall: Lost Vale Relics display on the upper level of the Hall of Lost Empires.
det: Looted from a Frost Giant in the Forgotten Vale. From the Wayshrine of Resolution, cross the rock bridge and follow the path down and along the river until you reach the lower (southern) entrance of Sharpslope Cave. Go through the cave (there's a Shellbug inside which can be mined for it's Chitin). From the upper (northern) entrance of Sharpslope Cave, head down the path to the right and cross the bridge to the left. Follow the rocky path to the left all the way up until you reach a gate to a small paddock with some Falmer corpses. The Frost Giant will be behind the gate, together with a Falmer Excavation Site.
nt: *The Paragons must be placed manually on display and do not count towards the total display count. *The Emerald Paragon is needed to open a portal at the Paragon Platform to Forgotten Vale Overlook. Here Unknown Book, Vol. 2 is found, one of the four books for the Forgotten Vale Books Quest.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
h_hall: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: Can be crafted at any forge using the following items: *Shield of the Crusader, Reforged Shield of the Crusader or Fastened Shield of the Crusader *1 Silver Ingot.
nt: *Requires Divine Crusader and its CCPH patch. *The item is not included in the original creation, but was added by the patch. *Although the item is marked as a shield in your inventory, it is placed in the "Shoulder" slot when equipped, so you can wield another shield in your left hand. *You can switch between this item and the Standard, the Reforged and the Fastened version at any forge using 1 Silver Ingot. *The museum display accepts only one of them (and their replicas). *You need to have either this item or one of the other versions in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

p: Misc. Weapons Collection in the Main Hall of the Hall of Wonders.
h_hall: Misc. Weapons Collection in the Main Hall of the Hall of Wonders.
det: When Goldbrand and its CCPH patch are installed OR when AOBSE and its Legacy patch, as well as Shadowrend and its synergy patch from CCPH are installed: *The Katariah, in a master locked chest behind the desk in the Emperor's Quarters during the Dark Brotherhood quest 'Hail Sithis!'. *If you instead choose to destroy the Dark Brotherhood, it will be received from a Penitus Oculatus messenger. nt: *Requires CCPH. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *Depending on installed patches, the weapon obtained from the chest on The Katariah or from the courier will be Goldbrand (LotD) or Shadowrend.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Right Displays in the 1st Room of the Armor Displays.
h_hall: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: Ragnvald Canal, in a magically sealed chest. Needs the Blessing of Stendarr or the Signet Ring of Sir Amiel to open.
nt: *If the Divine Crusader creation and its CCPH patch are installed, this item will be replaced by the CC version. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the Divine Crusader relics. There is information about the crusader relics in the book Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3. *The Crusader Display will always show the Heavy version of the armor, regardless of the type placed. *You can switch between the light and heavy version at any forge using 2 Silver Ingots. *This item is based on the Gauntlets of the Crusader from The Elder Scrolls IV: Knights of the Nine. *The enchantment increases with the player's level: Stage 1: up to Level 14, Stage 2: Level 15-24, Stage 3: Level 25-34, Stage 4: Level 35-44, Stage 5: Level 45-54, Stage 6: Level 55 and up.

p: Crusader Relics Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes. | Deepholme: Right Displays in the 1st Room of the Armor Displays.

nt: *Requires Divine Crusader (replaces the LotD version). *You can switch between this item and the Reforged version at any forge using 1 Silver Ingot. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *Although there are separate displays for the standard and reforged versions, at least on one of them a replica must be placed since you can't have both originals. *You need to have either this item or the reforged version in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the Divine Crusader relics. There is information about the crusader relics in the book Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3. *This item is based on the Gauntlets of the Crusader from The Elder Scrolls IV: Knights of the Nine.

Attribution's Share is accessed through a portal at the Tomb of Lyrisius near Kagrenzel in the Velothi mountains. If you loot Aldantar for his key and read his journal, you'll be able to retrieve a new spell (Sirilonwe's Ritual) that allows you to switch between this sword and Eltonbrand at will.

p: Bookshelf 2 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 2 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: Note: This is the only City Guide which has a fixed location. *Darkfall Cave, on a shelf near the first wayshrine and the place where Knight-Paladin Gelebor sleeps. *Randomly found placed in the world. *Randomly given by Latoria as reward for One Man's Junk. *Randomly sold by Urag gro-Shub, Neloth, Talvas Fathryon and Babette. *Randomly sold by General Goods Merchants, Khajiit Traders, Court Wizards, Orc Wisewomen and Fences. The Ascadian Isles is a region of lush, green, well-watered southern lowlands where most of Vvardenfell's agriculture is found. The area includes Pelagiad, Suran, Vivec City, and Ald Sotha along with the inland lakes and waterways of the Ascadian Isles proper. The urban areas of Vivec and Ebonheart of the southern coast are densely populated; the inland Ascadian Isles are dotted with small farms and large plantations. The climate is temperate and comfortable, with moderate rainfall. Ebonheart is the seat of the Imperial government for Vvardenfell district, and a busy center of maritime trade. Castle Ebonheart is the home of Duke Vedam Dren, the district's ruler and Emperor's representative. Also located at Castle Ebonheart are the Vvardenfell District Council chambers and the Hawk Moth Legion garrison. The officers, docks, and warehouses of the East Empire Company are also found in Ebonheart. Vivec City is the largest settlement on Vvardenfell, and one of the largest cities in the East. Each of the great cantons is the size of a complete town. The High Fane and the palace of Vivec are visited by hundreds of tourists and pilgrims daily. Citizens flock to the Arena for entertainments and war games. Outlanders mostly confine themselves to the Foreign Canton, while natives live, work, and shop in the Great House compounds and residential cantons. Ald Sotha is a splendid Daedric ruin within sight of Vivec City. Though exotic and picturesque, it is a dangerous site, haunted by old magics, dark cultists, and their Daedric summonings, and not recommended for sightseers. Suran is an agricultural village in the northeastern corner of the fertile Ascadian Isles region. Two popular pilgrimage sites are nearby -- the Fields of Kummu and the Molag Bal's Shrine. Pelagiad is a newly chartered Imperial village between Balmora and Vivec City on the western edge of the Ascadian Isles region. The village is right outside the Imperial Legion garrison at Fort Pelagiad. The houses and shops are built in the Western Imperial style, and Pelagiad looks more like a village in the western Empire than a Morrowind settlement. The Ashlands are the dry, inhospitable wastelands surrounding the lower slopes of Red Mountain. The Ashlands extend to the Sea of Ghosts in the north, and elsewhere form a wide margin between the blighted Red Mountain region and other geographic regions. The village of Maar Gan is the only sizable permanent Ashlands settlement; Ald'ruhn, the district seat of House Redoran, is on the margin of the region. Ashlanders hunt for game here, and their herds find sparse grazing. It rains rarely, and suffers frequent ash storms. Maar Gan is a small isolated village in a remote region north of Ald'ruhn. The Maar Gan shrine is an important Temple pilgrimage site. The Ashlanders Urshilaku tribe has a permanent settlement at Urshilaku camp in the Ashlands region north of Maar Gan village. The rugged coast and islands of northern and eastern Vvardenfell are called Azura's Coast. The region is rocky, infertile, and largely uninhabited, except for the outpost at Molag Mar, the Telvanni settlements at Sadrith Mora, the wizard towers at Tel Aruhn, Tel Mora, and Tel Branora, and Ahemmusa camp and the remote fishing villages of Ald Redaynia and Dagon Fel on the north coast. There are no roads; most travel is by boat. Despite the rocky terrain, a variety of plants thrive on the regular rainfall. Sadrith Mora is the district seat of House Telvanni, and home of the Telvanni Council, though only one Telvanni councilor actually lives in Sadrith Mora. Sadrith Mora is an island settlement, and accessible only by sea and teleportation. The town is large, with many services, but it is open only to Telvanni retainers; outsiders must confine themselves to the Gateway Inn. Tel Branora is the tower and seat of the eccentric Telvanni wizard named Therana. The tower and its tiny village are located on a rocky promontory at the southeasternmost tip of Azura's Coast. Tel Fyr is the Telvanni tower of Sorcerer-Lord Divayth Fyr. Beneath the tower is the Corprusarium, a refuge-prison where the deranged, distorted victims of the deadly corprus disease are housed and tended. Tel Aruhn is the Telvanni tower of Arch-Mage Gothren, Telvanni Sorcerer-Lord and head of the Telvanni Council. The associated settlement is a sizable village, and the site of the Festival Slave Market, the largest slave market on Vvardenfell. Tel Mora is the Telvanni tower of Mistress Dratha, an ancient wizard of the Telvanni Council. The small settlement includes a few craftsfolk and a tradehouse. Tel Vos is the tower of Telvanni wizard and council member Master Aryon. Tel Vos is a peculiar blend of Telvanni and Western architectural styles, and is close to Vos village. Bal Fell is the "City of Stone," an ancient First Era ruin in the southeastern islands and promontories of Azura's Coast. The site has a nasty reputation, and several Telvanni wizards currently have competing camps of hirelings and adventurers exploring and looting there. Legend says that Bal Fell was built on the site of an ancient Daedric worship center. The Ashlander Ahemmusa tribe has a permanent settlement at Ahemmusa camp on a rocky promontory at the northeastern tip of the Vvardenfell mainland in the Azura's Coast region. The western coast of Vvardenfell from Seyda Neen north to Gnaar Mok is called the Bitter Coast. The salt marshes and humid swamps of this region are uninhabited, with the only settlements found at the good harbors of Gnaar Mok, Hla Oad, and Seyda Neen. Also called the Smuggler's Coast, the region's secluded coves and islands provide refuge for criminal trade, and the frequent rain and fog hides small boats from Excise cutters. The piercing light of the Grand Pharos at the mouth of the harbor of the port village of Seyda Neen is a beacon to mariners throughout the Inner Sea. Most visitors from the Empire make landfall at the port of Seyda Neen, where they are processed by the Imperial Census and Excise Commission agents of the Coastguard station. The Coastguard cutters docked here control smuggling and piracy on the Inner Sea. Hla Oad is a tiny isolated fishing village on western Vvardenfell in the Bitter Coast region. A rough track along the River Odai connects Hla Oad with the town of Balmora. Gnaar Mok is a tiny island fishing village in the Bitter Coast region of western Vvardenfell. The regular rain and dark soils of the Grazelands produce the rich grazing for Ashlander herds that give the region its name. The region lies in the northeast of Vvardenfell, sandwiched between the Ashlands and Azura's Coast. Permanent settlements include Vos village and the towers of Tel Vos and Tel Fyr. The Ashlanders of Zainab camp move their herds across the plains in search of fresh grazing. There are no roads or tracks, but travel is easy across the open plains. The Ashlander Zainab tribe has a permanent settlement at Zainab camp, near the village of Vos in the Grazelands region. Located inland in the southeast of Vvardenfell, Molag Amur is an uninhabited wasteland of rocky hills, steep-sided ravines, lava pools, and barren ash pavements. Pathfinding and travel is extremely difficult in this trackless wilderness, and is complicated by frequent ash storms. The Ashlanders of Erabenimsun camp hunt game here, but few others venture into this region. The worst part of Molag Amur, called the Great Scathes, is considered impassible even by the Ashlanders. The outpost at Molag Mar is a fortified stronghold on the southeastern edge of the desolate Molag Amur region. Pilgrims bound for the nearby pilgrimage sites at Mount Assarnibibi and Mount Kand take refuge at the outpost's hostels, comforted by the garrison of Redoran and Buoyant Armiger crusaders stationed at the stronghold. The Ashlander Erabenimsun tribe has a permanent settlement at Erabenimsun camp, an isolated hut settlement in the middle of the desolate Molag Amur region. The dominant feature of Vvardenfell, Red Mountain, is a vast volcano in the center of Vvardenfell. The outer slopes are steep and rugged, and the crater is deep and dotted with surface lava. The Ghostfence, a magical barrier which blocks travel as well as seals in the harmful, disease-laden weather called 'blight,' rings the volcano's outer slopes, and is broken only at Ghostgate. Within the Ghostfence, rain never falls and the sun never shines; the only weather is the red and deadly ash-blight. Ghostgate is the gate citadel of the Ghostfence Ordinator and Buoyant Armiger garrisons. Ghostgate sits astride the only gap through which the monstrous hosts of Dagoth Ur might emerge from Red Mountain to threaten the rest of Morrowind. The Ghostfence itself is a colossal magical artifact that completely encircles Red Mountain and prevents the Blight from spilling its corruption across the rest of Vvardenfell. The western highlands of Vvardenfell are called the West Gash. The region extends from the Sea of Ghosts on the northwest coast to the inland town of Balmora, where the region is sandwiched between the Bitter Coast and the Ashlands. The trading village of Gnisis is north of Ald'ruhn, and the fishing villages of Ald Velothi and Khuul lie on the north coast. The town of Caldera lies near Balmora. The herds of the Ashlanders of Urshilaku camp graze on the sparse but hardy highland vegetation. Balmora is the district seat of House Hlaalu, and the largest settlement on Vvardenfell after Vivec City. Good roads lead north to Ald'ruhn and south to Caldera, Seyda Neen, and Vivec City. The Imperial Legion garrison of Fort Moonmoth lies south of Balmora. Caldera is a recently chartered Imperial town and mining corporation. The Caldera Mining Company has been granted an Imperial monopoly to remove raw ebony from the rich deposits here. Caldera has the appearance and flavor of a Western Imperial town. Ald'ruhn is the district seat of House Redoran, and a large settlement. The Redoran Council Chamber are located inside the shell of an ancient extinct giant crab. Tracks lead north to Maar Gan and Gnisis villages and south to Balmora. Gnisis is a small mining and trade village astride the silt strider caravan route between the northwest West Gash and Ald'ruhn. Ald Velothi and Khuul are tiny fishing villages on the northern coast of the West Gash. The large island of Sheogorad lies north of Vvardenfell. This island and its associated lesser islands are a maritime wilderness extending north from Vvardenfell into the Sea of Ghosts. The region is largely hostile and uninhabited, with two small villages at Ald Redaynia and Dagon Fel. Only Dagon Fel is reached by ship services; all other island-to-island transport must be provided by the traveler. }}

p: Right Wall - First Case display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Right Wall - First Case display of the Vigilant Room in the Hall of Oddities.
det: A total of 11 can be found in various locations throughout Coldharbour. *Eastern Sewers, on a low table to the right of the trapdoor leading to the Gardener's House. *Fort Sepredia, looted from Duke Kh-Utta. *Fort Welkynd, on the table in Chef River Jumper's kitchen. *Naarifin's Inquisition Court, looted from Dorald the Incompetent. *Nenyond's Underground Priory, Funeral Temple, looted from the hanging skeleton of Abbot Silorn, at the entrance to the hallway after the maze room. *Old Temple of the Eight Divines, in a hidden area above the room with the magicka sigil, requires jumping across banner supports. *Prison Tower, on the table by the iron maidens in the torture room on the top floor. *Silorn's Priory, looted from The Black Worm. *Torture Garden outside the Gardener's House, looted from Thannor the Gardener. *Ultar's Charnel, looted from Count Lead. *Waterfront District, Slave Trader's House, on the small table.
nt: *Requires Vigilant. *The increase of Stamina is permanent and stackable, so a total of 110 points can be gained (100 if you spare one to put on display).

loc: Jelidity's Knapsack next to a bedroll and a withered corpse located on the mountain southeast of North Windcaller Pass
det: Found in Jelidity's Knapsack next to a bedroll and a withered corpse located on the mountain southeast of North Windcaller Pass. Massive Spoiler ahead! You have been warned! [How to get there] left|350pxIt is almost if not literally impossible to reach the spot on foot, so bring a horse with you. Southwest of the entrance to North Windcaller Pass there is a small path that leads up the mountain. Follow it until it starts descending again, turn left and carefully (!) start climbing (best to save your game before), hugging the mountain face on horseback until you reach the plateau where Jelidity's Knapsack is located. If Skyrim's Paraglider mod is installed another method to access where Jelidity's Knapsack is located is to use the Paraglider. Travel to either Throat of the World or High Hrothgar and jump to glide to the site. As you approach lose altitude until you are able to safely land. The site is easily seen from above.
nt: *One of the items that can be stored in Arkayn's Tool Bag. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *One of the tribute items that are named after several special people who have helped in one way or another during the development of LOTD and LOTDSE. *Technical note: There's a controller quest running in the background ("Astrolabe Handler", DBM_JelsAstrolabeHandler) which handles the map markers.

p: Daggers Display on the Upper Gallery.
h_hall: Daggers Display on the Upper Gallery.
det: After beginning the quest, the player is directed to Bleakcoast Cave. Within Bleakcoast cave is the mod-added area 'Bleakcoast Cave Depths'. A chest is located within the Bleakcoast Cave Depths, on a table and is protected by a magical shield and three Atronachs. A Fire, Ice and Storm Atronach will appear one after the other and fight the player upon entering the dungeon. A gate will also close behind the player, preventing retreat until the atronachs are killed. Once all three atronachs have been killed, the shield will deactivate and the chest can be looted to retrieve Krahvalok. There is also a note with instructions to use Krahvalok in an optional objective.

det: Forgotten Vale, on a stone ledge below the bridge to the Inner Sanctum, in the hands of Luca's frozen corpse which carries the backpack containing his Journal. To reach the spot, turn left up the slope after exiting the Glacial Crevice, towards the Frost Giant that holds the Diamond Paragon. From there a Falmer excavation site should be visible further up the mountain. From the excavation site, face towards the Falmer buildings and the large bridge to the Inner Sanctum, hug the right wall and follow the ledges upwards past some bird nests until you see the gold ore vein with Luca's corpse next to it. Alternatively, before the bridge to the Inner Sanctum, turn right until you see the Falmer village from above and carefully (!) drop down.
nt: *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *Although the classic version lacks a description, the effects are the same. *One of the tribute items that are named after several special people who have helped in one way or another during the development of and . *Technical note: There's a controller quest running in the background (DBM_LucaPickaxeFormHandler) which adds the pickaxe to the mining tools formlists to be able to actually mine ore and stalhrim.

p: Left Wall - left display of the Interesting NPCs Room in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Left Wall - left display of the Interesting NPCs Room in the Hall of Oddities.
det: *Dwarven Rubble: Druadach, an unmarked location on the northern river bank NE of Druadach Redoubt, in [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/locations/the-reach/beatrice Beatrice's] camp, one on a barrel, one inside the tent. * The Winking Skeever in Solitude; when you pay [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/locations/quest-npcs/vaughn Vaughn] (choosing the largest sum) to receive the blessing of Zenithar during the quest '[http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/quests/full-quests/the-way-of-the-nine The Way of the Nine]', he gives you a bottle. * [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/locations/quest-npcs/lorne/ Lorne's] Shack N of Cracked Tusk Keep, two bottles on a shelf. * After overhearing a conversation between two Nords on the shoreline of the Sea of Ghosts SE of Bleakcoast Cave, you can rescue Treads-the-Ashes from a locked underwater chest. He provides a bottle of Mogo's Mead as a reward, claiming to have received it from "some Breton" (that is Beatrice, actually). * Ironheart Cave east of Mor Khazgur, visited during the quest [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/quests/darkened-steel/darkened-steel/a-daedra-in-the-dark 'A Daedra in the Dark'] in the [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/quests/darkened-steel/ Darkened Steel] questline, in [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/locations/quest-npcs/deirdre Deidre's] room. Three bottles each on two tables. Taking one is considered stealing unless Deidre really likes you. * Viola Giordano's House in Windhelm, two bottles on the table at the party during the quest [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/quests/darkened-steel/a-daedra-in-the-dark/cat-and-mouse/deathbroker/ 'Deathbroker'] in the [http://3dnpc.com/wiki/interesting-npcs/quests/darkened-steel/ Darkened Steel] questline.
nt: * Requires . * Ironheart Cave is a "no weapons" zone (meaning drawing even your bare hands is impossible), so if you get caught stealing, run like hell! * Viola Giordano's House visited during 'Deathbroker' is not the vanilla location, instead it is a separate cell added by Interesting NPCs.

p: Moon and Star Display on the Bottom Floor of the Dragonborn Hall.
h_hall: Moon and Star Display on the Bottom Floor of the Dragonborn Hall.
det: Obtained from a strongbox at the Shrine of Azura after helping the Nerevarine during Moon and Star's main quest. Alternatively it can be obtained by killing the Nerevarine during the quest as a death item.
nt: *Requires Moon and Star. *WARNING: If you kill the Nerevarine, the next time you go to sleep he will appear in a dream and place a powerful curse on you. Check Active Effects and you’ll see the Curse of Azura. The curse reduces your Health by 50 and your Speech by 25. The curse is permanent and cannot be undone. Your actions also change how the villagers of Little Vivec interact with you. Selyse at the Tradehouse will no longer sell or buy items from you and Bal-Ran will no longer train or speak with you.

p: Deepholme > |OriginSSE =
h_hall: Deepholme
det: The Phantasmal chest randomly transports itself to 1 of 30 locations all across Skyrim and Solstheim every 24 hours. The location is randomly chosen, but the chest is very apparent and easy to spot, usually positioned above cave entrances or along prominent ridges. It emits a loud chiming sound like the chime sounds in the Temple of Kynareth, that can be heard from a distance making it easier to find while exploring.
nt: The Phantom Cache can be started by finding Sanamia's Journal (6) found inside a knapsack at a Riekling camp on one of the small island clusters north of Solstheim, which is also incidentally Sanamia's place of demise. The quest will auto complete when discovering the chest, even if the journal was not found. The text of the journal itself gives hints of 2 possible locations the chest can appear in: Angarvunde and Arcwind Pass. When the chest is activated, it will vanish, but will add a novice conjuration spell "Summon Phantasmal Chest". This spell can be used to summon the chest at your location for a few seconds to allow use of the chest. When it disappears, it will be stored in an utility cell.

p: Planetarium
h_hall: Planetarium
nt: To activate the Planetarium, one of the 5 Planetarium Cubes (the Aetherium Cube, the Constellation Cube, the Planetary Cube, the Sky Cube, or the Storm Cube) must be placed in the receptacle. The Constellation Cube can be used to reset perks for skills, similar to Black Book: Waking Dreams, but is far more convenient, as it does not require the player to travel to Solstheim to read the book, and allows the player to keep the book on the display. This is also useful if the player has a mod that made resetting perks that way (i.e., the Miraak follower mod) unavailable, or wishes to do so before starting the Dragonborn DLC.

p: Remiel display on the upper floor of the Explorer's Society Guild House.

det: Given to you at the end of Remiel's quest "Remi's Crossbow Crucible" if you tell her to give it a try, together with 100 of Remi's Crossbow Bolts. Massive Spoiler ahead! You have been warned! [Detailed walkthrough] *After completing "The Dwemer Specialist", tell Remi to relax. Now speak to her about the ideas running through her head and the quest will start. *Bring her the materials needed: **2 Dwemer Cogs **8 Dwemer Gears **1 Dwemer Lever **3 Firewood **6 Dwarven Metal Ingots *She will start constructing the crossbow, wait 24 hours until the quest updates. *Speak to her her again and choose the dialogue option "I'll give it a try". She will hand over the finished crossbow and the quest concludes.
nt: *Requires and the . *If you tell her to teach her how to use it, you'll receive Remiel's Crossbow instead. They're identical, except for the different name and BaseID. *The display can take both originals and the replica. *Having the item in your inventory or completing the quest unlocks the replica recipe.

While the invisibility effect will wear off after 30 seconds, the frost damage effect will NOT!

p: Lost Vale Relics display on the upper level of the Hall of Lost Empires.
h_hall: Lost Vale Relics display on the upper level of the Hall of Lost Empires.
det: Looted from a Frost Giant in the Forgotten Vale. After reaching the lower lake from the Wayshrine of Sight go north until you see the Frost Giant carrying the Amethyst Paragon, close to the first waterfall. To the left of the waterfall are some stairs leading up the hill, go up until you reach the upper end of the fall. Follow the river upstream until you see the Paragon Platform and the second waterfall. The Giant carrying the Sapphire Paragon is found to the right of it. Alternatively, a small path to the right at the northern end of the upper lake (the frozen one with the dragons Voslaarum and Naaslaarum) east of the Wayshrine of Resolution also leads to the location.
nt: *The Paragons must be placed manually on display and do not count towards the total display count. *Using the Paragon at the Paragon Platform will open a portal to an otherwise unreachable section of the Inner Sanctum with an abundance of leveled gems, several pieces of leveled elven gear, and three chests of leveled loot.

p: Rare Curios: 1st Right Display in the Hallway of the Hall of Wonders.
h_hall: Rare Curios: 1st Right Display in the Hallway of the Hall of Wonders.
det: *Can be purchased from Khajiit Traders. *With Saints & Seducers installed, it also can randomly be found in Hollowed Stumps in the Solitude Sewers. *With installed, it can instead be acquired in the following ways: **Looted from Scalons on the Shivering Isles. **Randomly sold by Theodor Gorlash at The Near Corgi Shop. **Randomly sold by Sees-the-Moon.
nt: *Requires Rare Curios. *The Museum display only accepts the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

det: Witchmist Grove, on top of a barrel inside the hut.
nt: *Requires BadGremlins Collection. *SSE BaseID is taken from the "Merged all 4 BSA Version" found under Optional Files.

p: Serana Display in the Follower's Room A.
h_hall: Serana Display in the Follower's Room A.
det: Volkihar Keep, on a dresser in Serana's room.
nt: *Requires . *The item is considered a silver weapon which means it provides an additional 20 points damage bonus against Undead (including some Ghosts), Werewolves and Vampires. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

p: Weapon Plaque at the Left Wall in the Skyrim's Unique Treasures Room.
h_hall: Weapon Plaque at the Left Wall in the Skyrim's Unique Treasures Room.
det: Blacksmith Quarters in Windhelm, on a shelf in the top floor bedroom.
nt: *Requires Skyrims Unique Treasures. *In earlier versions of the mod the item had the prefix Unique. SSE only: *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

p: Lost Explorer's Journals on the top shelf of the Left Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House.
h_hall: Lost Explorer's Journals on the top shelf of the Left Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House.
det: In Schneider's Knapsack next to his skeleton half-buried in sand, located at a tree east-southeast of Kolbjorn Barrow on Solstheim. Apparently Schneider was killed by Ralis Sedarys who took Schneider's Sextant.

p: v5: 2nd shelf of the Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House. v6: 2nd shelf of the Right Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House.
h_hall: v5: 2nd shelf of the Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House. v6: 2nd shelf of the Right Trophy Case in the Explorer's Society Guild House.
det: *Outside Kolbjorn Barrow on Solstheim, carried by Ralis Sedarys. Can either be pickpocketed, taken from his corpse or taken out of his inventory if he becomes a follower. *SSE only: If starting the game through the addon to , the item is found at the start of Akaviri Rising, on a table in the tent across from you.
nt: *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available. *You must have an Archaeology level of at least 10 to use the sextant. *One of the tribute items that are named after several special people who have helped in one way or another during the development of and .

p: Pillar Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
h_hall: Pillar Display on the Main Floor of the Hall of Heroes.
det: Windhelm sewers system, Subterrane, in a room to the north-west. An Ancient Windhelm Key is required to open the way. One key can be found in the Thalmor hideout in Old Canals of the sewers, another can be found in a vampire lair at the east end of Forlorn Catacombs. *Fastest way to reach the Thalmor hideout is to pick the master-locked door of Niranye's House (or pickpocket the key from her). Entering the Old Canals through a trapdoor in the basement drops you directly in front of the Thalmor. *Fastest way to reach Forlorn Catacombs is to pick the adept-locked trapdoor just before the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Windhelm's Hall of the Dead. *Fastest way to reach Subterrane is using the manhole to the Palace Underworks right before the entrance to the Palace of the Kings. Dive into the central cistern to reach Subterrane. Follow the icy path to the north-west and dive through a short water-filled passage. Get rid of the two draugr waiting here and solve the pillar puzzle (Whale, Eagle, Whale) to open the final gate. Shardslayer is guarded by the oversized and uniquely named Frost Atronach Kamal Snow Demon that must be defeated to access the blade (you can use ranged attacks, it's too big to fit through the entrance).
nt: *Requires Skyrim Sewers 4. *A book titled the Book of Frozen Tears is present in the room Shardslayer is located. It describes how the blade came to rest underneath Windhelm.

p: Deepholme > |Origin =
h_hall: Deepholme
det: This item is necessary to finish the quest "Shattered Legacy." More specifically the Soul of Miraak (also known as "Miraak's Soul" or "Miraak's Soulgem" or "The Soulgem of Miraak," the name seems to vary) is an item obtained from Miraak's corpse. As the name implies it is a soulgem that contains the soul of Miraak, The First Dragonborn, and the villain of Skyrim's Dragonborn DLC. By the time you get to this point in Shattered Legacy, you may not have obtained the gem. If you have not, try using the Black Book "Waking Dreams" to return to the spot of Miraak's death, and searching his corpse again. (This can happen, for example, if you installed "Legacy" after finishing the Dragonborn content. Or if you didn't realize that you'd at some point need Miraak's soul in your pocket.) If you are still having difficulty finding it, search every place you store items. It's all-too-likely that you stored it someplace you forgot about.

det: The Space core is acquired when the player is close to the Western Watchtower. The core will be seen falling from the sky, leaving a trail of smoke and audibly shouting "SPAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAACE!" before landing in the ruined shack in the fire place. p: Khajiit will follow Displays in the Follower's Room B.
h_hall: Khajiit will follow Displays in the Follower's Room B.
det: Found at the Windhelm docks after completing Chatur'jo's unmarked quest. Massive Spoiler ahead! You have been warned! [How to complete the quest] *First, seek out Chatur'jo. He's found in different places, the easiest place would be Whiterun. He's sitting in a niche of the city wall behind Warmaiden's. *Speak to him repeatedly until he's finished his ramblings und has nothing more to say than "I am here, but I am not here..." *Now travel to the College of Winterhold and enter the Arcanaeum. Chatur'jo's Journal is floating beneath the ceiling, use a spell or bow and arrow to make it fall down. *Read the journal and a new spell tome will be added to your inventory, the Translucent Tome. *Read the tome to learn a new spell, the Word of the Skooma Cat. *Travel back to Chatur'jo and speak to him. After finishing the conversation, use the spell on him. *Chatur'jo will turn invisible and vanishes completely after a while, leaving behind a letter from Sheogorath himself, This Guy Again?. *Read the letter and travel to the Windhelm docks, the Splintered Club will be on one of the piers, together with the Skooma Cat's Attire and the Skooma Cat's Boots.
nt: *Requires and the . *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

p: Dibella Case display in the Hall of Oddities.
h_hall: Dibella Case display in the Hall of Oddities.
det: Can be stolen from Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften during the Thieves Guild quest 'Taking Care of Business'. The statue will not spawn until after the quest has been started. There are three ways to safely acquire the statue for the Museum: *Visit Haelga last. She has heard about the other two "customers" and will pay her debt willingly. The statue can then be stolen. *If you visit Haelga first or second, she isn't willing to pay. Choose the brawl option in the dialogue with her and steal the statue afterwards. If you steal it beforehand, the brawl option isn't available; the statue will be removed from your inventory and is lost. *If you have stolen the statue before brawling with Haelga or completing the other two "customers", you can manually place the statue in the appropriate display to forcibly remove it from your inventory before speaking to Haelga.
nt: Not to be confused with the other Dibella Statues found in the game. Aside from the name, there is a visual difference and this item does count towards the Museum total display count.

Important: With Version 6 of Legacy and up to The Curator's Companion v7.0.1 the book was misplaced behind the wall to the right of the research station. p: 2nd Gated Bookcase on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: 2nd Gated Bookcase on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: *Bards College in Solitude, around the corner from the entrance, on a bookshelf (Local map). *Calcelmo's Tower, Understone Keep in Markarth, on a Dwemer shelf in the room with the charcoal rubbing supplies (Local map). *Volkihar Keep, 2 copies, one on a small round table on the balcony, another on a table in the Blacksmith's room (Local map). *Castle Volkihar Undercroft, in the room with the lever for the first bridge, on a table. *Darklight Tower, before entering the hagraven's room, on a shelf (Local map). *Dayspring Canyon outside Fort Dawnguard, after the Refugees Camp is established, on a barrel in one of the tents. *Dead Drop Mine in Fort Dawnguard, on a shelf (with three Mudcrab Chitin) under a wooden platform (Local map). *Dragonsreach in Whiterun, in Farengar's study, on the left bookshelf (Local map). *Dwemer Museum, Understone Keep in Markarth, on a stone table in the southwestern corner (Local map). *Fellglow Keep, on a shelf at the outer wall of the library. *Fort Dawnguard, 2 copies on the ground floor, one on a bookshelf in the sleeping area, another on a bookshelf beside the . *Fort Neugrad, on a shelf in the circular room south of the main entrance. *Fort Snowhawk, on a bookshelf in the room west of the back entrance (Local map). *Hall of the Vigilant, after it has been destroyed by the vampires, on the floor. *Hob's Fall Cave, on a bookshelf in the ritual room (Local map). *Ilinalta's Deep, on a shelf in the room with the arcane enchanter. *Palace of the Kings Upstairs (Southern Section) in Windhelm, on a shelf in Wuunferth the Unliving's laboratory (Local map). *Raldbthar, on a stone table in the left room from the entrance (Local map). *Rannveig's Fast, in Sild the Warlock's room, on a shelf at the trapdoor cage. *Redwater Den, on a wooden crate near the forge. *Ruins of Rkund, Karagas' Maze, on a table near the entrances to the first maze (Local map). *Ruunvald Temple, at the end of the dungeon, on the table with the alchemy lab (Local map). *The Arcanaeum in the College of Winterhold, on a table in the southeast part (Local map). *Katria, can be looted off her body in Arkngthamz. *The book can also spawn in the inventory of any magic-based human enemies such as Necromancers.
nt: *Reading the book for the first time adds the misc. objective 'Investigate the ruins of Arkngthamz' which then starts the quest Lost to the Ages. *If you have and its LOTDPSE patch installed, one copy is needed for the signed book.

p: Autographs of Skyrim Display on the 3rd Floor of the Library.
h_hall: Autographs of Skyrim Display on the 3rd Floor of the Library.
det: Bring a copy of The Aetherium Wars to Taron Dreth. He appears as a random encounter after completing Lost to the Ages and can sometimes be found at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth. He will give you the signed copy in return (see Notes).
nt: *Requires and its LOTDPSE patch. *Originally, the signed copy is also called The Aetherium Wars. The patch adds the Signed appendix. *Warning: Do not carry any of the Aetherium items crafted during Lost to the Ages when speaking to Taron, or he will immediately turn hostile! Also, mentioning Katria during the conversation (which is inevitable) will make him attack, so let him sign the book before continuing with the conversation.

det: Forgotten Vale, on an icy slope leading to the vast frozen river. From the Wayshrine of Sight, head southwest until you come across a path in the middle of a ridge. p: Bookshelf 4 on the 1st floor of the Library.
h_hall: Bookshelf 4 on the 1st floor of the Library.
det: Forgotten Vale, near the Glacial Crevice. Travel upriver, towards the entrance of Glacial Crevice, but do not enter. At the fence entrance, turn around to face north. You will see two rock pathways. Take the pathway on the left that crosses the river and continue to cross over one more rock bridge. Take the Falmer bridge to the left and turn right to cross another rock bridge leading down to a lone Falmer tent. The untranslated book (Unknown Book, Vol. 3) will be inside on a table. Urag gro-Shub at The Arcanaeum will buy the book and give you the translated version.
nt: *This book is part of the unmarked Forgotten Vale Books Quest. *Only the translated version can be displayed in the museum. {{Content| Foreword The dates noted in this diary are translated literally. This verbiage matches no known modern measure in time, and is assumed to be a custom form of counting the days and months. Excavations of ancient Falmer slave quarters have turned up brass vessels, very similar to a deep bowl, with twenty markings crudely etched onto the inside. Falmer scholars theorize that this bowl would be placed under a drip of water coming from overhanging rock and as the bowl filled, the water's level would reach these markings, thus indicating a crude passage of time. Because of this diary, the vessel has been called a "kulniir", a primitive Falmer timekeeping device. ---- Third Marking, Tenth Kulniir It feels like years since we were forced into hiding. I dare not write where we stay for fear of endangering the good people of this house should this diary be discovered. We have been shown a kindness by this family once known to the Snow Prince. Even in death his great influence has ensured our safety. We were separated from many of our kin along the road when it became increasingly difficult to travel discreetly in our numbers. We were forced to go our separate ways and travel only at night. I have heard no news of where the others may have gone and fear I never shall. Our lives are forever changed. Seventh Marking, Tenth Kulniir In the night I find it difficult not to focus on times past. There are moments in my rest when I still hear the laughing of young ones at play in the valley. Other times I see the pale fleckes of happy moments which were once so common in the land of the Snow Elves. I try not to dwell on these memories too long. Often the surroundings make it impossible to dwell on any happiness. We have been locked together in such close quarters for so long. We grow tired of each other's company. Even the strongest of us have faltered, with nothing to do but think on what is lost. I wake each day to forlorn faces and am reminded of where we are and all we have left behind. We are all yearning for a day when we can emerge from hiding and walk freely in the light once more, but I fear we are losing all hope that such a day will even come. Tenth Marking, Tenth Kulniir I tire of the tears of women and children. My own have run dry. The men have begun to look upon us as if we are all weak, yet we have survived the same trials as they. I cannot bring myself to think on the numbers we lost in battle, yet I cannot force the images of my own losses from my mind and now, in a time when our people should be banding together in feels, we are drifting apart. The Nords have truly won. Our once great pride and unity are shattered. If we lose hope now we will never survive. Today many, myself included, have tried to speak out in voices of reason. There can be no hope without talk of our future. We can make no difference if our spirits remain broken. Eighteenth Marking, Tenth Kulniir We know that we can never again be the Snow Elves and live freely. In that world we will forever be in hiding in one form or another, but there is no reason we cannot live life with the sun and the wind against our skin. There are those here who are friends to us and plan to help us once the threat has ended. We know now to survive, we must be born anew outside. We will appear. We belong here inside. We will carry our truth and our scars. |} }}

q: The Hand of Glory' given by Greigor in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath or
nt: *The legend states that you will die when the candle goes out. If you use up the whole candle, you will be strangled to death. *The Hand changes its appearance (and BaseID) depending on how many times it has been equipped. If you reach Stage 4, it's high time to get rid of it. *You can rid yourself of the curse by starting the quest Breaking the Curse. *Although it is described as a staff, it cannot be used as such. *If you destroy the Dark Brotherhood, you will be unable to obtain the item if you kill Greigor or everyone else before finishing the quest. t: Armor Set (Light, Heavy Armor or Robes)
p: Deepholme > |Origin =
h_hall: Deepholme
det: Reward from the Shattered Legacy quest. The player has to decide between the Light, Heavy and Robes version of the set. The Light and Heavy versions of the set are identical in appearance.
nt: *Using the Greatsword of Ancient Tongues or similar will reduce the amount of pieces equipped and therefore also the bonusses. *A replica of the Sword of Ancient Tongues can be used in the off-hand to dual-wield but will not grant extra bonusses. *The bonus from The Moon and Star does not stack with the "Extra effect" perk from the Enchanting skill tree. *In earlier versions of Legacy of the Dragonborn the armor looked like the [https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/66130/| Dragon Carved Armor], or [https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/18940/| Knight of Thorns Armor] before that. It is only since V19 that there is a Robes version of the outfit. *The effect of the outfit can bug sometimes (you can notice your speed dropping). You can set the number of pieces manually via the console with: set DBM_VisageEquipped to 8. ru:Сет брони Драконоражденного Category:Armor Category:Upper Gallery

t: Armor Set (Light, Heavy Armor or Robes)
p: Visage display in the Upper Gallery. Only displayable after the completion of Shattered Legacy. | Deepholme: |OriginSSE =
h_hall: Visage display in the Upper Gallery. Only displayable after the completion of Shattered Legacy.
det: Reward from the Shattered Legacy quest. It can be crafted with a Soul Ingot at the Dragonsoul Forge. The player can choose between a Heavy, Light and Robes version of the set and switch at any time (to do this unequip the Grasps and interact with the Forge). Switching between sets will remove all enchantments and improvements.
nt: *The Visage of the Dragonborn armor set is based on The Gifts of Akatosh mod. *Shield of Reman Cyrodiil only needs to be in the player's inventory to apply its set bonus boost. It does not need to be worn, allowing for maximum inbuilt boosts even with two-handed weapons of Ancient Tongues. *A replica of the Sword of Ancient Tongues can be used in the off-hand to dual-wield but will not grant extra bonuses. *The bonus from the Ring of Zurin Arctus DOES stack with the "Extra effect" perk from the Enchanting skill tree., allowing you to enchant an item with three enchantment. This is not the case in LE. *In earlier versions of Legacy of the Dragonborn the armor looked like the [https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/66130/| Dragon Carved Armor], or [https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/18940/| Knight of Thorns Armor] before that. It is only since V19 that there is a Robes version of the outfit. *The outfit was considerably nerfed since V4 (or LE edition). *Of the items used in the Visage, only the Lord's Mail has a separate display. The others do not have displays prior to being used in the armory. ru:Сет брони Драконоражденного Category:Armor Category:Upper Gallery

nt: *Requires Sunder & Wraithguard. *Increases health and stamina by 20 and magicka by 50 when wielded together with Keening. *Increases one-handed weapon damage by 15% and stamina regeneration by 50% when wielded together with Sunder. *This item replaces the LotD Version. *If and its corresponding synergy patch are installed, this item and the Legends Lost quest will be disabled, you'll receive the Tools of Kagrenac Version through that mod's questline instead, using the CC model. *The display can take both the original and the replica. *You need to have the original in your inventory for the replica recipe to be available.

nt: *Requires . *Y'tharil is not flagged as essential, and although she seems to be a decent mage, she is physically rather weak. p: Royal Armory display in the Hall of Secrets.
h_hall: Royal Armory display in the Hall of Secrets.
det: Swindler's Den, carried by Kematu, only present during the quest 'In My Time of Need'. Can be pickpocketed from him (Misdirection perk needed) or looted off his corpse if the player decides to kill him.
nt: *Requires Royal Armory. *Due to the fact that 'In My Time of Need' can be started early in the game (shortly after Dragon Rising is completed), the player probably lacks the appropriate pickpocketing perk. So if you want to spare Kematu, delay the quest until you got the perk. Additionally, it's difficult to pickpocket him unnoticed: In Swindler's Den he's been surrounded by his warriors, later at the Whiterun Stables Saadia is present. *The item has undergone some changes over the years. In the original mod it is called Yokunda's Edge, earlier versions of the LotD patch renamed it to Yokuda's Edge, the latest patch calls it Yakuda's Edge. Additionally, lowers the value to 973.
